plan: Cut all leveraged ETFs to zero to minimize downside.
Reduce QQQI concentration to 20% to meet mandate.
Exit all other high-risk AI/Software and Semiconductor leveraged positions.
Focus on capital preservation with a larger cash buffer.
This plan prioritizes stability over aggressive growth.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and high-beta names, accepting lower potential gains for a more stable equity curve and lower drawdowns.

plan: Reduce concentration in QQQI to 20% and trim other leveraged ETFs.
Introduce AAPL as a new position from the scanner.
Maintain a blend of broad index, income, and select tech.
This approach balances risk reduction with growth potential.
A modest cash buffer is maintained for flexibility.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It reduces concentration and leverage while adding a quality name, aiming for steady growth with controlled drawdowns. It seeks to capture upside while mitigating the impact of market volatility.

plan: Reduce QQQI concentration to 20% to meet mandate.
Significantly increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU).
Add AAPL from the scanner and increase AI/Software positions.
This plan embraces higher leverage and concentration for maximum growth.
Strict stop discipline is crucial due to amplified risk and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-conviction names, accepting substantially higher potential drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact performance.

plan: Increase QQQI allocation to 30% to maximize income generation.
Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Trim CRWD to reduce exposure to volatile tech.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
A significant cash buffer is maintained for stability.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through steady distributions. It shifts the portfolio towards income-generating assets like QQQI and away from high-beta and leveraged positions. While prioritizing low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs, and distributions are not guaranteed.
